A heavily [[Forest/Legends|forested]] '''moon''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Virgillia]] in the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]],<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> a part of the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]]<ref name="Online Companion" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated along the [[Lipsec Run/Legends|Lipsec Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Atlas" /> During the [[Virgillian Civil War]] between the [[Aristocracy]] and the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]], a [[Unidentified refugee camp|refugee camp]] containing [[Gender/Legends|women]] and [[Youngling/Legends|children]] was located there.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

The camp was at one point discovered by a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] informant, and, as a result, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jarroth]] and the crew of the Imperial [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Stormwind]]'' were sent to investigate it. They first [[The Burning/Legends|tortured]] several [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] on the suspicion that they were hiding information about Free Alignment [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] and then [[Death/Legends|killed]] everyone in the encampment when they attempted to fight back. It was the first mission of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Rannd Delckis]], and he found the incident so horrifying that he subsequently defected to the Free Alignment.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Virgillia's forested [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book was written by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Virgillia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the moon, in grid square I-18.<ref name="Atlas" />
